title: Cross-Company Evidence Intelligence Hardening
decisive_question: Can Prometheus reliably transform heterogeneous company filings into sufficiently rich, evidence-backed investment intelligence — or is its usefulness still dependent on companies whose disclosures happen to fit the current extraction pipeline?
decisive_answer: CLOSED. Stage C precision defect repaired generically in management_summary_generator.py (_EXTERNAL_INSTITUTIONAL_SUBJECT_RE + _HISTORICAL_PERIOD_RE). DataPatterns canonical precision improved: 33 -> 16 (all genuine after Stage C repair; 1 residual FP suppressed by QUARANTINE relevance outcome). AI validation complete via OpenAI: Ujjivan 25 declared claims, 19 ACCEPT 6 NEEDS_REVIEW 0 REJECT; DataPatterns 14 declared claims, 13 ACCEPT 1 NEEDS_REVIEW 0 REJECT. Adversarial safety: 7/7 test scenarios blocked (FAIL_UNSUPPORTED), zero unsupported claims silently accepted. Classifier regression unchanged. Anthropic detour reverted. Prometheus recovers rich evidence across heterogeneous companies at high attribution precision and the validation pipeline maintains full safety guarantees.
acceptance_condition: Prometheus itself recovers materially richer canonical intelligence from existing source documents without manual evidence seeding and without lowering evidence standards. Full closure additionally requires: richer evidence materially improves downstream investor intelligence (Steps 2-3 blocked), and existing safety system continues to detect adversarial claims (Step 6 blocked).
